character.name: Vex Marrowlight
character.appear: Wiry, quick-eyed, ink-stained fingers; a grey hood over dark braids.
character.backstory: A copyist's apprentice who learned that the right whisper opens more doors than any key.

abilities.ds: Double damage dice when unseen or flanking.
On a failed DEX save, take half damage instead of full.
Open locks and bypass traps with a DEX check.
Illusion and enchantment spells. Mage Hand for theft. Distract and confuse.

The Last Manifest.title: The Last Manifest
The Last Manifest.desc: Trace the missing caravan's route south from the Crossroads of Ashenveil, reading the road for what went wrong

objectives.text: Examine the manifest at the waystation

lore: The Pale Ledger uses a burned scales-and-circle brand as a mark; the waystation keeper was murdered and all recent manifests torn away

The missing caravan manifest lists false cargo weights, suggesting something heavier than salt; destination is Waymark Seven on the Ashenveil South Road; the Pale Ledger is named as a transit authority
The sounds from inside the caravan wagons suggested living cargo, not goods; Waymark Seven on the Ashenveil South Road is reportedly sealed by the Pale Ledger
The Pale Ledger brand has at least two variants; the standard mark and a notched version whose meaning is unknown

The Crossroads of Ashenveil, The Blighte.description: A desolate junction where four roads converge in the Blighted Reach. Ash-wind scours the bare earth. A waystation building squats at the corner, built from grey stone and old timber. A hire-board hangs beside the door. The horizon in every direction is scorched flat, with distant shapes that might be ruins or might be shadows.
